verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm syncing expenses to QuickBooks Online, with finalized reports exported automatically, and connecting a workspace to NetSuite for expense syncing. A 'Multi-level GL coding' claim hints at GL mapping control, but nothing documents class or department mappings or how a finance lead configures them. missing for 10: Xero integration evidence, explicit GL account/class/department mapping configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync behavior.
